disagreements.topic: Tesla-SpaceX merger odds before the horizon
disagreements.positions: Agent 3 cites Kalshi at 61-74% by May 2027 and calls the round-1 ~47% figure too low. Agents 1, 2, 4 and 5 use ~47-54% by mid-2027 and ~18% for a 2026 announcement.
disagreements.resolution: The 74% Kalshi reading is from late July and is stale. The live Kalshi market for a merger before May 1, 2027 sits at ~48c. The majority figure is right. All five agents treat the price effect as two-sided, so no agent's ladder depends on it and there is no ladder change.
disagreements.evidence: Kalshi company-merger market page (~48% Yes, Sept 2026); Motley Fool 2026-07-30 (the 74% figure was a July 25 record high); Prediction News/StockTi on swings between 33% and 74% during 2026.

disagreements.topic: Robotaxi expansion toward Musk's ~12-state year-end target (right-tail fuel)
disagreements.positions: Agents 1-5 all use expansion toward ~12 states as the main right-tail catalyst. Agent 3's base case has 8-12 states. Agent 4's base has ~a dozen metros, and agent 5's has 10-15 metros.
disagreements.resolution: Unsupervised service runs in six TX/FL cities (Austin, Dallas, Houston, Miami, Orlando, Tampa) with ~200 unsupervised vehicles. That is two states, three months before the deadline. Agent 3's 8-12-state base case looks optimistic. The shortfall is widely reported, so it is mostly priced, but it argues for a slightly lower middle of the distribution rather than a fatter right tail.
disagreements.evidence: Electrek 2026-09-03 (1M unsupervised miles); Yahoo Finance 'Can Tesla Meet Musk's 2026 Unsupervised Robotaxi Target?'; The Charge Port robotaxi tracker, Sept 2026.

disagreements.positions: Agents cite a ~461k consensus with a Goldman 435k / Barclays 475k range. Agent 2 marks the print '-', and agents 1, 3, 4 and 5 mark it '?'.
disagreements.resolution: The more recent Visible Alpha consensus is lower, at ~454k. UBS sees 470k but still down ~5% YoY against ~497k in Q3 2025. The company-compiled consensus is not yet out. That is a year-on-year decline under any estimate, which is mildly negative for core auto and supports agent 2's sign. It is a small effect on a 12-month horizon.
disagreements.evidence: eletric-vehicles.com on the UBS note (Visible Alpha 454k); Benzinga on the Goldman 435k cut; Motley Fool 2026-09-24.

disagreements.topic: Fundamental fair value and whether it binds within 12 months
disagreements.positions: Fair values are $280-295: agent 1 at $295 (includes the NTM P/E leg), agent 2 at $290, agent 4 at $285, and agents 3 and 5 at $280 (agent 5 cut energy and FSD values). All agree it will not bind within 12 months, and medians sit at $352-362.
disagreements.resolution: Nothing to settle by search. All five now use the verified inputs: 3.95B shares, 2027 EPS of $2.17 (~171x), and net cash of ~$27.4B. Agent 3 notes a $34.2B alternative, a ~$2/sh difference that does not matter. My fair value of ~$285 is the midpoint. I accept the partial-drift framing: medians ~5% below spot while fair value sits ~23% below.
disagreements.evidence: StockAnalysis statistics and forecast pages (Sept 24-27, 2026); TSLA closed ~$372.6 on Sept 26, flat against the as-of close.

disagreements.positions: Agent 1 $265, agent 4 $255, agents 2, 3 and 5 $250. The disagreement is over whether $255-290 is 'convergence to fair value' or already a break.
disagreements.resolution: ~$255. It sits under the $297-304 July capitulation low by ~15%, and fair value (~$285) is within ordinary drift from it. A sustained trade there would need an NHTSA-forced Cybercab pause or exemption path, a serious robotaxi incident, or core auto turning loss-making.
disagreements.evidence: Agent reasoning; NHTSA Special Order (Sept 10, sworn response due Sept 30, 21 requests, max ~$139M penalty).

confidence_reason: Round 2 forecasters agree within ~1-2pp at every strike. My searches settled only disagreements that do not move the ladder: agent 3's 74% merger odds are stale (live Kalshi ~48%), and the price effect is two-sided anyway. Two facts lean mildly negative: unsupervised robotaxi is still in 2 states against a ~12-state year-end target, and Q3 deliveries are tracking down YoY (Visible Alpha ~454k). They justify only a ~0.5pp trim in the middle, not a replacement of the mean.
thesis_break_reason: About 31% below spot and ~15% below the $297-304 July 2026 low, which already priced a 1.4% operating margin and negative FCF. It sits far enough under the ~$285 fundamental anchor that a sustained trade there would not be plain convergence to fair value. It would most likely mean the autonomy thesis is impaired: NHTSA forcing a Cybercab pause or a capped Part 555 exemption path, a serious robotaxi incident, or unsupervised expansion stalling. It could also mean core auto turned loss-making while >$25B/yr capex is funded with debt.

fair_value.method: Midpoint of the five revised agent fair values ($295, $290, $280, $285, $280; mean $286). All now use 3.95B shares, 2027 consensus EPS of $2.17 (~171x at spot) and ~$27.4B net cash. The agents' sums of the parts put ~65-70% of value in robotaxi/FSD and Optimus option value. P/E cross-checks at 115-130x on 2027-28 EPS give $260-299. Fair value sits ~23% below spot and, per all agents, is not expected to bind within 12 months.

key_drivers: Valuation is mostly option value. At $1.47T on 3.95B shares, TSLA trades at ~171x 2027 consensus EPS of $2.17. The agents' fundamental anchors cluster at $280-295, ~23% below spot, but the market has kept a narrative premium (analyst mean $397, median $415).

Autonomy execution: ~200 unsupervised robotaxis in six TX/FL cities against Musk's ~12-state year-end target, and the NHTSA Special Order on Cybercab FMVSS 135 compliance (sworn answer due Sept 30), which could force a pause or a capped exemption path.
Cash burn and core auto: Q2 operating margin was 1.4%, FCF -$1.1B, 2026 capex >$25B and up to $30B of debt facilities. Q3 deliveries are tracking down YoY (~454-461k vs ~497k).
Delayed regulatory catalysts: the EU FSD vote is December at the earliest, with 7 of 27 states on board, and full China approval is still pending.
Tesla-SpaceX merger is a two-sided wildcard at ~48% before May 2027 on Kalshi.
summary: The five revised forecasts converge tightly: median ~$352-362, sigma ~0.5, fair values $280-295 on corrected share count and $2.17 2027 EPS, so TSLA carries a ~25% narrative premium over fundamentals. Checks this round settled only small points: merger odds are ~48% (not 74%) and two-sided in price effect; unsupervised robotaxi is still confined to TX/FL well short of the 12-state goal, and Q3 deliveries look down year on year. I keep the mean ladder with a ~0.5pp trim through the middle (P(>=372) = 0.457) and put the thesis break at ~$255, about 15% under the July low. Near-term swing factors are the Sept 30 NHTSA response, the Oct 2 deliveries print and Q3 earnings.
